facts.text: Centreville was founded in 1792 on the turnpike road at the village of Newgate, named for the popular tavern.
During the Civil War, Centreville's ridge offered a view and the town became a supply depot for both sides, even hosting the first military-only railroad, the Centreville Military Railroad.
Historic Centreville Park lets visitors walk through preserved Civil War fortifications and see homes from two distinct time periods.
The Centreville Regional Library, operated by Fairfax County Public Library, serves the community and reflects the town's emphasis on education.
Families from near and far visit Centreville for its rich history and endless kid-friendly activities, making it a popular spot for history lovers and families alike.
